Custom Bag Manufacturing Process

From logo design to sample confirmation, bulk production and delivery, we make custom bag sourcing simple for B2B buyers.

1

Inquiry & Product Recommendation

~1 day

Tell us your needs and our professional consultants will recommend the best solution. You can reach us by phone, email, or WhatsApp with the following details:

  • Bag Type: Canvas / Non-woven / felt
  • Size & Specs: Provide specific dimensions or reference samples
  • Quantity: 100 pcs MOQ, larger quantities get lower unit prices
  • Print Content: Logo, graphics, text, and other design elements
  • Special Requirements: Colors, techniques, accessories, and other custom needs
2

Artwork Layout & Sample Confirmation

1-2 days

Send us your logo or design file and we will provide free layout design service. Our professional designers will optimize the layout to match the bag dimensions for the best print results.

  • Submit Design: AI, PSD, PDF, PNG formats accepted
  • Free Layout: Designers optimize layout for bag type
  • Mockup Preview: 3D mockup or sample photos provided
  • Revisions Supported: Multiple revisions until you are satisfied
3

Bulk Production & Quality Control

3-5 days

We support pre-production sampling. Once approved, we proceed with bulk production using advanced equipment and strict quality control at every stage.

  • Pre-production Sample: 1-2 samples for quality confirmation
  • Fabric Inspection: Strict fabric quality check before production
  • Print QC: First-piece approval and random inspection
  • Final Inspection: 100% visual inspection before shipment
4

Packing, Shipping & After-Sales Support

1-2 days

On-time delivery with multiple shipping options. Comprehensive after-sales support to ensure your satisfaction with every order.

  • Standard Packaging: Standard carton packaging, custom packaging available
  • Multiple Shipping Options: Express, freight, and dedicated line shipping
  • Quality Guarantee: Free returns and exchanges for quality issues
  • Long-term Partnership: Client profiles maintained for faster reorders

Common Questions

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

We support orders from 100 pcs, breaking the traditional factory bulk threshold. This is ideal for startups, event promotions, small-batch testing, and more. Larger quantities enjoy lower unit prices.

How long does production take?

Standard orders are delivered in 7-10 days, with rush orders available in 3-5 days. The exact timeline depends on product type, quantity, and printing complexity. We will provide an accurate delivery date when confirming your order.

Can I get a sample first? What are the costs?

Yes, sampling is supported. Sample fees range from 200-500 CNY depending on the product type. When you place a bulk order, the sample fee is fully deductible from the order total.

What printing techniques do you support?

We offer silk-screen printing, heat transfer, DTG (digital printing), embroidery, foil stamping, UV printing, and more. Different products suit different techniques — our consultants will recommend the best option for your needs.

Can I customize bag sizes and colors?

Absolutely. We support full custom sizing and can match fabric colors to your brand. Just provide a Pantone color code or physical sample.

What if there are quality issues?

We guarantee free returns and exchanges for quality issues. Strict quality inspection is performed before shipment. If any defects are found, please contact us within 7 days of receipt and we will resolve it promptly.
